name: vibe-tracker-worker
// allowScripts: npm 12 blocks package install scripts by default to limit supply-chain risk.
These three need theirs to work, and all three are build tooling, not app code:
workerd  - the Cloudflare Workers runtime binary, downloads the right build for your OS
esbuild  - the bundler wrangler uses, downloads its platform binary
sharp    - image library pulled in by wrangler, needs a native binary
None of these end up in the deployed Worker. Only src/*.js and hono do.
